The '''1969–70 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 34th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 21 September 1969 and ended on 10 June 1970. [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] won their second consecutive and tenth Greek title.

The point system was: ''Win: 3 points'' - ''Draw: 2 points'' - ''Loss: 1 point''.
